1.o: يرسل لبيد جنوده من أجل جلب زوجته لمنزله بعد عودته من الصيد، ويرسل لبيد رسالة إلى شقيقها ليخبره أنها ليست زوجته وأنها مجرد جارية، ويحاول أبو نويرة الوقوف أمام معاملة لبيد السيئة للجميع، ويحلم سالم بالسفر إلى الهند.

2.o: يخبر سالم أبونويرة أن عليه أن يتناول الخمر لكي يشعر بحال أفضل، يأمر وائل ابنه أن لا يخرج مع خاله سالم بسبب شربه للخمر وتعلقه بالنساء، يكتشف سالم أن له ابنه تدعى ليلى، ويأمر سالم بالتخلص منها.

3.o: ينتقد الجميع تصرفات سالم من شرب الخمر ومجالسة النساء، ولكن يدافع عنه أبى شيبان، ويحاول سالم معرفة مصير ليلى وهل تم قتلها أم لا، ويستعد الجميع للمعركة المرتقبة بين القبيلتين.

4.o: تدور المعركة، ويذهب وائل للبحث عن الهاربين عند سالم، ويكتشف سالم أن هناك خطة من أجل اغتيال لبيد، ويذهب سالم من أجل البحث عن الهاربين.

5.o: ينجح جيش سالم في التغلب على جيش لبيد والتخلص منه، ويترقب الجيش رد الملك الكندي للانتقام منهم، ,ويحتفل الجميع بالتخلص من لبيد، ويأمر الملك بجلب جليلة له للزواج منها.

6.o: يعد الملك بسوس أنه سيزوجها من وزيره نبهان، ويذهب سعد ليسألها في الأمر فتخبره أنها لن تتزوج أحد، وتخبر جليلة خالتها أنها لن تتزوج إلا وائل، ويذهب الجميع لمعرفة تطورات زواج جليلة.

7.o: يرفض الجساس فكرة زواج جليلة من التبع اليماني، ويقسم وائل أن اليوم الذي ستتزوج فيه جليلة من التبع اليماني هو يوم موته، ويخبر وائل قومه أن موقفه مع جليلة سيكون موقفه مع أي امرأة في قبيلته يتقرب منها التبع.

8.o: تشعر جليلة بالخوف من تضحيات الرجال من أجلها وخاصة وائل، ويذهب جيش وائل وسالم إلى الملك التبع اليماني من أجل خداعه والتخلص منه.

9.o: يحاول أبونويرة معرفة سبب مساعدة سالم لوائل، فيخبره أنه شقيقه وأنه سيفعل أي شيء من أجله، ويصر شاليش على المشاركة في خطة سالم، ويتم تأجيل خطة مواجهة الملك.

10.o: يقوم التبع اليماني بتعيين عمران ساعدًا له ومشرفاً على الأمن، ويقرر بنو قيس الانضمام لجانب وائل ضد التبع، وتستعد المملكة للاحتفال بزواج جليلة والتبع، بينما يتحصل سالم على كلمة سر الحرس الخاص بالتبع.

11.o: يعثر حراس الملك على صناديق بداخلها سالم والجنود، ويقوم سالم بقتلهم والبدء في تنفيذ خطة التخلص من الملك، وتنجح الخطة ويتم قتل التبع ويهرب سالم وجليلة والبقية.

12.o: يحاصر جيش وائل جيوش الملك التبع، وبينما تعاني قوات جيش التبع من العطش الشديد، يتبارز الوزير مع وائل على أمل قتله والسماح لجيشه بشرب الماء، وينجح وائل وجيشه في تحقيق إنتصار كبير، ويتم تنصيب وائل ملكًا بدلا من التبع.

19.o: يكتشف سالم أن شقيقه كليب قد تعرض للغدر والقتل من قبل جساس، ويتم إحضار جثة كليب (وائل) من أجل دفنه، وتتمنى جليلة لو أنهم قتلوها بدلاً من كليب.

20.o: يعثر الزير على رسالة كليب شقيقه، وهي "لا تصالح"، ويقرر سالم الانتقام من الجساس، وتتدهور حالة جليلة وشقيقته، ويفترق همام وسالم ويتفقان أن لا يتواجها في الحرب.

21.o: يحاول شيبان استفزاز سالم ودفعه للغضب والأخذ بثأر شقيقه كليب، ويتمنى سالم لو أنه مات بدلًا من شقيقه، ويرفض الجساس تسليم نفسه على قتله لكليب، ويعتبر أن ما فعله هو أمر بطولي.

22.o: يتم دفن الملك الكليب (وائل)، ويفقد سالم صوابه، فيرثيه بالشعر ويقسم على الانتقام من كل من خانوه، ويتقابل سالم وجساس أمام البحيره، ولكن يعجز سالم عن معرفة من هو بسبب كثرة شربه للخمر، وتحاول عائلة كليب إقناع سالم بالأخذ بالثأر.

23.o: يكتشف سالم أن جليلة قد تم طردها من الديار، ويقسم سالم على أن لا يخلع عباءة الحرب، وأن لا يوقفه شيء عن الانتقام من الجساس، ويرى سالم شقيقه كليب في المنام، فيخبره أنه سيأخذ بثأره.

24.o: يبحث بنو كليب عن الثأر من الجساس، ويحاول سالم الابتعاد عن الخمر، وينتشر خبر قيام جساس بقتل سلامة والأخذ بثأره لنظلة، وتنشأ العداوة بين القبيلتين.

25.o: يموت شيبان على يد الزير عن طريق الخطأ، وينتشر خبر موت سلمة، مما يدفع البسوس للانهيار، ويقود سالم قبيلته للمعركة ضد الجساس، وتنشأ المتاعب بين سالم وجليلة الذي يترك لها حرية الرحيل.

26.o: يذهب شورحبيل إلى سالم ويقسم على الولاء له، ويعرض عمرو على جساس الزواج من شقيقته لتربية ابنها، ويكتشف سالم أن الجساس قام بتأجير فارس ملثم للتخلص منه.

27.o: يقترب موعد ولادة جليلة، ويموت شورحبيل في معركة بين سالم وهمام، ويطلب همام منازلة سالم، فيرفض سالم الأمر ويخبره أن ثأره مع جساس.

28.o: تنجب زوجة همام، فيسميه مرة، وتقع مبارزة جديدة بين جيش همام وجيش سالم، فتقع الكثير من الخسائر، ويقتل سالم صديق عمره همام، ويحزن عليه ويقسم أن يجعل جساس يندم على كل شيء.

29.o: يهرب جساس من المعركة ويتعلم بخبر موت شقيقه همام، وتخبر جليلة جساس أنه يتهرب من مواجهة الزير سالم، يسقط سالم في مطاردة ويتعرض لإصابة بالغة، فينتشر خبر وفاته، وتذهب يمامة لإنقاذ سالم.

30.o: تقع معاهدة بين القبيلتين من أجل حقن الدماء، ويتعاهد الاثنين أن لا يحمل أحدهما السلاح أمام الأخر بعد موت سالم، وتعثر قبيلة على سالم ويعالجوه، ولكنه لا يتذكر شيء عن ماضيه، فيسمونه تمساح.

31.o: يحاول سالم تذكر الماضي دون جدوى، وتشتاق يمامة إلى رؤية سالم، وتتمنى أن تعرف مصيره، ويغضب جساس من يمامة ويفكر في أن يزوجها لابنه كجارية.

32.o: تعاني قبيلة سالم من بطش وسيطرة جساس عليهم، ويتذكر الزير ماضيه، ويقرر العودة للانتقام من جساس، ويذهب له فيراه، ويدخل جساس في صدمة عندما يكتشف أن سالم على قيد الحياة.

33.o: يتقابل جساس وسالم وجه لوجه، فيتأكد جساس أن سالم على قيد الحياة، ويخشى جساس من قيام الحروب من جديد بعد سنوات الرخاء.

34.o: يستعد جساس ويحث جنوده على الاستعداد لقتال سالم، وتشك يمامة أن هجرس شقيقها، ويكتشف هجرس أن والده الحقيقي هو وائل، ويخبر جساس هجرس أنه قتل والده.

35.o: يحاول الحارث تدبير خطة لقتل سالم والانتقام من شقيقه، ويرفض هجرس عقد معاهدة مع جساس، ويعده بأن يقتله، ويحاصر رجال جساس هجرس، فيأتي سالم وينقذه في اللحظة الأخيرة.

36.o: يذهب هجرس للنزال مع جساس، وينجح في هزيمته وتصرخ ابنه جساس من أجل رحمة هجرس، ولكن هجرس يثأر لوالده ويقتل جساس، وهياجم سالم مرة، فيهرب هو وجده من المعركة.

37.o: يتعرض جيش بني مرة لفاجعة، حينما يسقط الجيش بأكمله في الرمال المتحركة، ويصبح بني مرة بلا جيش، ويخطط ما تبقى الهرب قبل انتقام سالم، ولكن قبل الرحيل يخطط الجميع للانتقام من سالم.

38.o: يظهر خطر كبير في شبه الجزيرة العربية، حيث يسعى إبرهة الحبشي للهجوم على مكة وهدم الكعبة بالفيلة، ويأتي رسول من جيش بني مرة، فيرغب سالم في قتله بينما يقف إمرؤ القيس أمامه.

39.o: يتبارز جيشي بني مرة وتغلب، ويسقط العشرات على يد جحرد، ويهاجم جيش بني مرة جيش تغلب ليلا، يسقط سالم على يد ابن عباد، ولكنه يعتق سالم من الموت.

40.o: يخسر بني تغلب الحرب ضد بني مرة، ويشعر سالم بالعار والحزن على الهزيمة، ويعقد هجرس معاهدة جديدة مع بني مرة، ويرغب سالم في الانتقام، ولكن هجرس يرفض الأمر، ويذهب سالم إلى موته برجليه.

1.o: Hanabi Yasuraoka is a second year high school student. She excels in class and is an upstanding student. But this girl shares a secret with Mugi Awaya, a boy in her same grade. Is love really something so beautiful? This is a love story for the most purest and disturbed.

2.o: As Hanabi and Mugi continue their fake relationship, there is a girl who is watching them very closely. Her name is Noriko Kamomebata. She has viewed Mugi as her own prince charming ever since she was a little girl. She adamantly refuses to believe that the two of them are dating. Meanwhile, Hanabi's best friend Sanae Ebato also has her doubts about Hanabi and Mugi's relationship.

3.o: Sanae is over at Hanabi's house for a sleepover when she comes out and asks Hanabi about her relationship with Mugi. After Sanae corners Hanabi on her bed to get the truth about Mugi, she steals a kiss...

4.o: The school's music teacher Akane Minagawa may have a squeaky clean image, but there is another side to her as Hanabi finds herself being manipulated by Akane. Just when Hanabi thinks she doesn't have anybody she can turn to, Sanae appears before her...

5.o: Hanabi is consumed by feelings of inferiority and loss as she blames herself for her own incapability after she sees Narumi confess his feelings to Akane. Meanwhile, Akane is irritated with Narumi for not making any moves after his confession until she hears something he says...

6.o: "I had sex with Mr. Kanai." Akane's bombshell lights a fire in Hanabi, and she vows to fight back. Meanwhile, she tries to go back to being friends with Sanae, but...

8.o: Summer break is here. Hanabi and Mugi both decide they will confess their feelings to their crushes after they complete their summer homework assignments. 9.o: Hanabi and Mugi made a promise to see each other again after they confessed their feelings to their respective first loves, but Mugi never showed up. Not soon after, Hanabi accepts an invitation from Sanae to go on a trip to Karuizawa with her.

10.o: Hanabi and her own weakness has hurt Sanae. Before leaving Karuizawa, the two of them make a promise to become friends again someday. The new semester begins, and despite telling Akane his feelings, Mugi is still letting her toy with him.

11.o: Mugi is her student since her tutoring days. Narumi is her colleague she only became interested in after she discovered Hanabi's feelings for him. Both men have fallen for Akane, but she still feels unfulfilled.

12.o: Hanabi, Mugi, Sanae, Moca, Narumi, Akane. Their intertwined fates have been cut, unraveled, and retied into a new thread. What is the wish that these emotionally clumsy people discover beyond their disturbed love?

Accusations abound from the opposition and the young men have no explanation in their defense. Will someone step up for them or will their follies be too severe for pardon?.

24.o: The grand vizier of the court at Hastinapur is accused by his own clan, paying the price of remaining neutral through the war. Vidur's deeds are rehashed and his intentions questioned. Was he really as indifferent and unbiased as he claimed? Was his (in)action driven by righteousness? Will his voice of reason that was never heard during the war, be finally heard now?.

Each character wants to know why they have been portrayed the way they have with some aspects (good or bad) highlighted and others overshadowed. As Ved Vyas explains both his inspiration and direction, he reminds the group of the impact the work will have on future generations. At the end his defense, everyone has had their turn to plead their case. All, except one.

26.o: A vacant chair remains in the courtroom, where Chitragupta usually presides. The Pandavas and Kauravas sit perplexed by this trial without a judge. As they look to one another, wondering who is to go on trial, they are reminded that a member of the court is missing. As the defendant takes the stand, everyone goes into a state of shock.

1.o: A warrior, Karn is eager to display his skills at an event where the talents of Kauravas and Pandavas will be put to test. Princess Uruvi arrives there.
Millie Harcourt and Jean McBrian travel to San Francisco and join forces with two American codebreakers to pursue a serial killer from their war days.

7.o: When a Russian diplomat dies in Iris's arms, the FBI sweep in to control the story and rule the death accidental and Iris is forced to get involved to protect her family.

1.o: Emma wakes up alone. In the woods. With no clothes on. When she finds something is wrong, she sets out to discover what she can’t remember.

2.o: Emma visits her father for help in dealing with her pregnancy, but a trip to the doctor’s office forces her to open her mind about how to handle the situation.

3.o: Emma does her best to prepare for motherhood, including taking up swimming. But something sinister may be lurking within the water.

4.o: Emma is getting her life in gear. New job. New car. But whatever is inside of her seems hell-bent on keeping her off track.

5.o: After an altercation with her dog, Emma starts having terrifying nightmares. Could they be a warning of what’s to come?

6.o: Emma tells Ty about her mom’s schizophrenia. After having a strange flashback during a moment of intimacy, Emma starts to question her own sanity.

7.o: Emma meets with another girl experiencing similar symptoms to hear her story. When she returns to the woods to look for answers, her paranoia starts to grow stronger.

8.o: Emma is detained in Dr. Green’s office due to a problem with her pregnancy. Faced with serious doubt, she’ll do anything necessary to escape.

9.o: After a daring escape, Emma runs to her father for help and learns more about her mother. She’s ready to risk everything to escape a similar fate.

10.o: Emma attempts to get an abortion to end her suffering. But when the procedure goes awry, she suspects that everyone is out to get her.

11.o: Emma goes into labor after running into the woods. When she learns the truth, will she be able to save her baby? Or herself?

1.o: مستغلًا الفرصة، يراهن "ريتشارد" على مادة أفيونية تسكّن الألم. فيما تحصل الخريجة الجامعية "شانون" على وظيفة في شركة "بيردو". أما "غلين"، فيعاني من إصابة عمل.

2.o: يشارك مريض يستخدم عقار "أوكسيكونتن" في مؤتمر لشركة "بيردو"، وتشهد "إيدي" على الآثار الضارة للعقار، بينما يواجه "ريتشارد" عقبات تحول بينه وبين تحقيق الأرباح.

3.o: يصبح لزامًا على "غلين" التخلص من السموم عندما يقوده إدمانه إلى قسم الطوارئ. وتجاهد "إيدي" من أجل إقناع رئيسها الجديد، وهو المدعي العام، بفتح قضية ضد شركة "بيردو".

4.o: تسعى "إيدي" لفضح شركة "بيردو" وتتمتع "شانون" بامتيازات وظيفتها لكنها تواجه معضلة أخلاقية. أما "غلين"، الذي وصل إلى حافة الانهيار، فتنفلت منه زمام الأمور في العمل.

5.o: يصل "غلين" إلى الحضيض وتشارك "شانون" في حفلة صاخبة للموظفين. فيما تكتشف "إيدي" دليلًا دامغًا يرتبط بقضيتها ضد شركة أدوية عملاقة.

6.o: يبدأ "غلين" في الإقلاع عن الإدمان وتعيد "شانون" تقييم دورها. أما "إيدي" وبقية الفريق، فيستخدمون أدلة جديدة لجرّ شركة "بيردو" إلى قاعة المحكمة، وتنتهي القضية بخاتمة مذهلة.

1.o: After being brutally murdered, Tomokui Kanata awakens in the body of a tiny green baby. He now has to begin a new life as a goblin in a brutal world, but fortunately, he has retained his special ability from his previous life.

2.o: While Gobrou organizes and trains the goblins of his generation, the generation that fathered them returns from their raiding. When he sees that they've captured a band of human women, he challenges the existing authority for control of their fates.

3.o: Gobe brings a small injured creature to Gobrou, who promises a great reward to him and the other goblins if they help reclaim her master's treasury. Afterward, Gobrou gets in trouble with the village women after falling to external temptation.

4.o: A band of elves calls upon Gobrou to help defend the forest from invading humans. However, the arrogance of the elves makes them difficult to negotiate with. Terrified kobolds run to the goblins out of desperation, bringing trouble right to their door.

5.o: Gobrou interferes with a human plot to steal the daughter of the elven chieftain. As they continue to prepare for conflict to ensue in the woods, the villagers keep growing in strength and evolving into new forms.

6.o: The human army finally advances on the Kudel Woods, and the Parabellum Mercenary company goes to meet them. Their training, power, and most importantly tactics are put to the test against organized forces of humans.

7.o: Parabellum and their elven benefactors put all their effort into ending the conflict with the humans as quickly as possible. However, the humans bolster their forces with a Brave blessed by the gods, who quickly finds himself crossing paths with Ogrou.

8.o: With the conflict with the humans behind them, Parabellum Mercenary Company releases what prisoners remain and offers them a provisional place in the mercenary company. However, several of these potential recruits think they deserve better treatment.

9.o: Ogrou and his group arrive at Trient, and he gives the abducted humans the chance to leave and live among their own people. A chance encounter with some ruffians gives Parabellum Mercenary Company an opportunity for a lucrative job.

10.o: Ogrou and his group arrive at a small human village called Mason. Out in the country, demi-human prejudices run even deeper. Shortly after their stop at the village, the two chef sisters start feeling strange.

11.o: Ogrou's travels are once again interrupted by unexpected childbirth. After checking up on the other groups of traveling Parabellum mercenaries, he becomes concerned after not hearing back from Ogrekichi.

12.o: Ogrou's group finally arrives at the royal capital and completes their job escorting the princess. They then decide to return home. However, they find that things are not as they had left them a mere month ago.

1.o: It’s Yu Ri’s first day at Law Firm Daejeong, 1 of Korea’s top 3 law firms. She thought she’d be joining the corporate department, but instead, she was assigned to the divorce department. Eun Kyung, the nation’s divorce attorney, instantly knows that Yu Ri isn’t the right material for a divorce attorney. However, Yu Ri tries to win the case in her own way.

2.o: Yu Ri’s straightforward nature struggles to comprehend some of the methods Eun Kyung employs. She is particularly shocked when she sees Eun Kyung persuading her clients to prioritize economic benefits over child custody. To Eun Kyung, who possesses far more experience than a novice, Yu Ri is just a rookie in the big leagues. What astonishes Yu Ri even more is Eun Kyung's reaction after she reveals a little secret she’s discovered.

3.o: Yu Ri is surprised to hear that Eun Kyung doesn’t want to divorce Ji Sang even after finding out about his affair with Sa Ra. Yu Ri finally starts a session with a client on her own and gets her first case. However, the client decides to drop the lawsuit. Yu Ri decides to quit working for the divorce team.

4.o: Eun Kyung asks Yu Ri to represent her for her divorce case against Ji Sang. Eun Kyung sends a letter of complaint to Sa Ra, letting everyone in the office know that she was involved in an unsavoury incident. Rumours about Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce circulate, but Eun Kyung doesn’t even bat an eye.

5.o: Ji Sang secretly leaks to a reporter that Eun Kyung might have an office husband and that she had an affair before him. Yu Ri decides to hear whether Eun Kyung and Woo Jin had an affair or not. Yu Ri convinces Eun Kyung to settle, but Eun Kyung doesn’t give in. Meanwhile, Yu Ri comes up with a brilliant idea to change the public’s opinion of Eun Kyung.

6.o: The first hearing of Eun Kyung and Ji Sang’s divorce trial begins, and neither side wants to give up the custody of Jae Hui, their daughter. Jae Hui misunderstands Eun Kyung’s intention and thinks she wants to let her live with her father. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case of a couple who want to give up their custody.

7.o: As soon as Sa Ra gets promoted to chief manager, she gets dismissed from the law firm. Ji Sang tells Sa Ra that he has no intention of marrying her even if he gets divorced, which leaves her devastated. Meanwhile, Yu Ri’s stepmom comes to see Eun Kyung and threatens her to fire Yu Ri.

8.o: Sa Ra is pregnant with Ji Sang’s child. However, Ji Sang’s lawyer advises him to abandon Sa Ra to win custody of his daughter. Sa Ra secretly puts the ultrasound picture of her baby in Jae Hui’s room, and Jae Hui eventually sees it. Meanwhile, Jae Hui finally meets the family investigator.

9.o: Eun Kyung finds out that Jae Hui knew about her dad’s affair with Sa Ra even before she did. Ji Sang breaks up with her after hearing what Sa Ra did to Jae Hui. Eun Kyung becomes emotional after finding out about Sa Ra’s pregnancy and what she did to Jae Hui. Hence, Yu Ri looks for a way to calm her down.

10.t: A Messed Up Story Or The Final Chapter
10.o: Jae Hui confides in Yu Ri that she wishes her parents’ divorce trial to end soon so that everyone can move on. She also chooses to live with Eun Kyung instead of her father and lets him know how much his lies hurt her. Meanwhile, Sa Ra miscarries her baby, and her relationship with Ji Sang ends.

11.o: Mr. Oh suggests Eun Kyung to go on a vacation and resign once she returns. Eun Kyung decides to go on a trip with Jae Hui, but things don’t go too smoothly. The Divorce Team gets twice as busy with Eun Kyung gone. Meanwhile, Yu Ri takes on a case and solves it on her own for the first time.

12.o: Daejeong signs an MOU with Chun Medical Foundation and takes a divorce case from its chairman, Chun Hwan Seo. Mr. Oh assigns the case to Yu Ri instead of Eun Kyung, and Yu Ri learns from him that he intends to fire Eun Kyung soon. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung finds out that Woo Jin will become the managing partner of Daejeong.

13.o: Chun Hwan Seo calls Eun Kyung to his house, and she finds his wife unconscious on the floor. Yu Ri, who was waiting outside the house, calls the police when she doesn’t hear from Eun Kyung. Meanwhile, Woo Jin comes up with a plan to deal with the mess Chun Medical Foundation put Daejeong into.

14.o: Eun Kyung decides to leave Daejeong and open up her own law firm. Although she starts out with a big ambition, it doesn’t turn out as well as she expected it to be. Yu Ri is given a choice to switch teams, but she hesitates. A new client visits Eun Kyung, but she sends her to Yu Ri, and Yu Ri does the same for Eun Kyung.

15.o: Eun Kyung realises that Yu Ri is the opposing counsel of her new client. They meet up to discuss a settlement, but they fail to find the middle ground. Eun Ho decides to leave Daejeong after much consideration and joins Eun Kyung’s new firm. After Eun Ho leaves the firm, Yu Ri realises how much he means to her.

16.t: Making A Choice The Right One
16.o: A year passes and Oh Dae Gyu's wife, Park Ae Yeon, files for divorce at Law Firm Daejeong, and Woo Jin assigns Yu Ri to take the case. Flabbergasted at facing his own company against him, Dae Gyu asks Eun Kyung to represent him. As Yu Ri and Eun Kyung try to settle outside the courtroom, Dae Gyu has a sudden change of heart. Meanwhile, Eun Kyung thinks of letting Jae Hui spend time with Ji Sang.

6.o: While working a celebrity murder, Lydia discovers the pros and cons of being in the spotlight. Meanwhile, six weeks after Nate's murder, Sammy finally returns to street patrol. Elsewhere, John voices his anger over the department's waste of money, man-power, and hours spent guarding the home of a celebrity suspected of murdering his estranged wife from the reporters trying to get a scoop.

7.o: When crime scene photos from the case of the celebrity suspected of murdering his estranged wife show up on the internet, all of the first responders are suspended, including Lydia and Josie. Further investigation proves the photos were the unauthorized pictures taken by Lydia using her phone, and she's shocked when she learns who was responsible for the leak. Meanwhile, Sammy fails to pick the right guy from the line-up for Nate's murderer, and Dewey and Chickie are involved in a high-speed chase that ends in disaster.

8.o: Sammy seeks answers in the desert, Lydia and Josie babysit an important alcoholic witness before a murder trial, and John and Ben go against procedure to help a child in need.

9.o: As John's back pain worsens, so does his drug problem, and Ben, about to finish his training period, is gravely concerned about him. Meanwhile, when a man wielding an automatic weapon goes on a killing spree inside a factory, Josie gets injured and Lydia must go after him alone. Elsewhere, Sammy decides to take a more active roll in the upcoming birth of his child..

10.o: On Ben's final day as a rookie, he decides to force John to get the surgery he needs to relieve his back pain which, in turn, will end his need for painkillers. Meanwhile, Josie discovers that her son is the man Lydia has been seeing. Elsewhere, Sammy decides to go back to regular patrol.

1.o: John returns to duty after recuperating from back surgery and meets his new partner, Officer Jessica Tang, a tough and disciplined cop with her own set of baggage from working the streets. Lydia, whose new partner is Detective Ruben Robinson, can't seem to escape helping a former CI who seems unable to stay out of danger, Ben, Sammy and Dewey chase an armed man into an elementary school, and Ben bumps heads with an intense street cop whose cynical attitude is affecting their work.

2.o: Things are gonna change with Joel Rucker as the new captain. Lydia and Ruben investigate a convenience store murder, and Lydia uses her typical compassionate charm to collect facts on her suspect from an unassuming grandmother. Meanwhile, John and Jessica get to test their physical abilities when they're attacked on the street. Elsewhere, Sammy and Ben ride with a mistake-prone officer, but Ben is the one making mistakes... mistakes that earn him some notoriety.

3.o: On Hood Day, a day where gangs seek retribution, LAPD is trying to keep the peace by camping out in neighborhoods prone to violence. Sammy and Ben leave their assigned neighborhood with disastrous results. Meanwhile, the neighborhood grabs a golden opportunity to seek a little retribution of their own against the gang banger who has been terrorizing them. Elsewhere, John and Jessica discover that another group of neighbors will go to any lengths to get a registered sex offender off their streets.

4.o: Jessica goes the extra mile to assist a homeless war vet obtain an ID so he can be admitted into a shelter . Meanwhile, Sammy is determined to save a dog after he accidentally shoots it in the leg. Elsewhere, Lydia struggles with a serious personal matter while she and Ruben investigate the murder of a man who sheltered and aided women in need.

5.o: John tries to save a suicidal teen in a situation that hits extremely close to home, and Sammy convinces a former addict to be an informant, with devastating consequences. Meanwhile, Jessica gets a visit from someone from her past, and Lydia and Ruben investigate a home invasion that appears to have been staged to cover up a murder.

6.o: Lydia dons a uniform and hits the streets when the shift is short a supervisor and she must fill in. Meanwhile, John and Jessica are stuck with a film crew tagging along on their calls. Elsewhere, Ben infuriates Sammy when he implies Sammy planted evidence.

7.o: Jessica and John exchange angry words after she lies to Internal Affairs about the facts surrounding her shooting of a teen with a toy. Meanwhile, Sammy continues to hold a grudge with Ben and Lydia continues to dodge questions about her condition.

8.o: Lydia and Ruben investigate the death of a young nanny, but first they have to find the kids who were in her care. Ben tries to intervene in the life of a prostitute with a daughter, but his efforts only make things worse. Tang gets an update about the boy she shot, but John still wants her to come clean about what really happened.

9.o: Ben finds himself heading down a slippery slope as he attempts to help the daughter of a prostitute, putting him in hot water with the woman's pimp. Lydia and Ruben investigate the murder of a gang-banger who may have been killed over a graffiti tag. Tang faces more questions about her shooting of an innocent bystander, which could determine whether she gets promoted to sergeant.

10.o: It's the last day on patrol for Tang, as she prepares to move to another precinct as sergeant. But first she wants to tie up some loose ends on the beat. Lydia is pressured to make a decision about the extent of her police duties during the rest of her pregnancy. With Sammy recovering from injuries, Ben and Dewey are partnered together. But Ben is bent on tracking down the prostitute he's been trying to help and then getting her and her daughter away from the abusive pimp controlling their lives.

1.o: Officer John Cooper clashes with his new boot, Gary Steele, a vet from Afghanistan. Lydia struggles to balance detective work and motherhood. Ben Sherman falls in with a sketchy crowd of cops, while Sammy Bryant is trapped in a hellish custody battle with Tammi.

2.o: After Mendoza is injured in a drive-by, Ben takes it upon himself to solve the case, much to Sammy's dismay. Lydia regains her footing as a detective while investigating the murder of a female boxer's husband. Tensions between Cooper and Steele finally come to a head during a traffic stop-gone-sideways.

3.o: A breakdown in the LAPD's dispatch system makes a difficult job even harder for the cops, all of whom are already grappling with communication issues. Lydia, in a moment of weakness, reaches out to her old flame, Terrell. John is assigned a new partner; Ben and Sammy's partnership is strained just as Ben makes a romantic connection on the job.

4.o: Lydia and Reuben track the killer of a man whose body was slow cooked down to the bone. John and Lucero settle into their new friendship during a day filled with strange calls. Ben and Sammy respond to an insane bank robbery in which the suspects throw cash out into the streets as they make their escape in a getaway car.

5.o: John is forced to think about what life will hold for him once he leaves the LAPD. Lydia connects with a man she sent to death row earlier in her career. Much to his chagrin, Sammy becomes a tabloid celebrity for the day after a very public act of heroism. Ben makes a dubious decision to get a drug dealer arrested. And a foot pursuit puts Dewey in danger.

6.o: The day’s events bring all of our cops face to face with some of their greatest fears. The death of a baby shakes Lydia to her core. Sammy is questioned by I.A. about his altercation with Tammi. A difficult day on the job causes Cooper to seek solace in Hicks but finds none. Ben becomes more deeply involved with Brooke while continuing to see Elena.

7.o: John takes drastic measures to try to save Hicks while being confronted with demons from his past. Sammy’s lie about the tape weighs heavily on his conscious. Lydia and Ruben track down a John Doe. Ben’s relationship with Elena becomes more serious.

8.o: The funeral of a major drug dealer brings gangsters of all kinds out of the woodwork, there is chaos in the streets but as our cops learn sometimes the greatest threats come from within. Lydia and Ruben investigate the drug related murder of Sgt. Hill’s son; they discover police corruption in the process and clash over how to handle it. Ben suspects that Sammy did not destroy the tape and decides to take matters into his own hands with tragic consequences. John sinks farther into his loneliness.

9.o: Chaos prevails in the city of angels when Cooper and Lucero are kidnapped and held hostage by a pair of tweakers. All of our cops join the frantic search to find their brothers in blue before it is too late. Sammy searches for Strokeface. Ben tries to throw Sammy off the trail while simultaneously dealing with an increasingly irrational Brooke.

10.o: John copes with the aftermath of his kidnapping. Sammy closes in on the real robbers. Lydia continues to pursue John’s kidnappers and becomes more intimate with Russell.

1.o: تعيد "بالارد" فتح قضية رجل مجهول غامضة بينما تسعى لتحقيق العدالة لشقيقة عضو المجلس المقتولة. وفيما تتعامل مع شهود مترددين وسياسات القسم ومخاوفها الشخصية، تكشف "بالارد" وفريقها النقاب عن أسرار دفينة تشير إلى وجود فساد داخل سلك الشرطة.

2.o: تحقق "بالارد" و"باركر" في مقتل مدبرة المنازل "يوليا كرافيتز". وفي تلك الأثناء، يجمع البحث عن آخر ضحيات القاتل المتسلسل "بالارد" مع المحقق المتقاعد "هاري بوش".

3.o: في عام 2006، اعتُبر موت عضو الأخوية "نيك ثاتشر" حادثًا في البداية. وعندما ينتشر مقطع فيديو يتهم الأخوية بارتكاب جريمة قتل، تُجبر "بالارد" وفريقها على إعادة فتح القضية.

4.o: تكتشف "بالارد" مؤامرة داخل قسم شرطة "لوس أنجلوس" مرتبطة بكارتل مكسيكية. تضفي أحداث جديدة الإثارة على قضية "بيرلمان" عندما تقود الأدلة إلى مواجهة خطرة مع مشتبه به مُحتمل.

5.o: حين يكتشف الفريق معلومات جديدة محيرة في قضية "بيرلمان"، يصبون تركيزهم على مشتبه به جديد.

6.o: يبلغ التحقيق الذي تجريه "بالارد" في قضية القاتل المتسلسل منعطفًا خطيرًا. وعندما لا يتبقى أمامهم إلا 72 ساعة لحل القضية قبل تحويلها إلى قسم جرائم القتل، يسرع الفريق لإيجاد روابط بين الضحيات.

7.o: يقدم "بوش" دليلاً صادمًا في قضية الفساد في قسم شرطة "لوس أنجلوس". بينما تنهمك "بالارد" وفريقها في التحقيق في جريمة قتل غامضة لشاب مراهق تربطه علاقة بعصابة محلية.

8.o: تصبح قضية "إيبارا" شخصيةً عندما تكتشف "مارتينا" أن شخصًا مقربًا منها هو عضو في حلقة فساد في قسم شرطة "لوس أنجلوس". يسرع الفريق لكشف هوية ضباط الشرطة الفاسدين الآخرين قبل فوات الأوان.

9.o: يتحول دليل جديد إلى اكتشاف صادم عندما يعلم الفريق أن القاتل المتسلسل كان في متناول أيديهم طوال الوقت.

10.o: تبدأ مطاردة قاتل "رولز" على مستوى المدينة بأكملها. تحصل "بالارد" على مستجدات غير متوقعة بشأن قضية الفساد في قسم شرطة "لوس أنجلوس".

1.o: A baby klipspringer is born on one of the coldest nights of the season and is miraculously nursed back to health. The California condor team at the Safari Park goes to unbelievable lengths to save this highly endangered species.

2.t: New Day for an Old Tortoise
2.o: Hunter the koala is ready for a mate. Jaws the Galápagos tortoise isn't feeling well, and the zoo staff works to bring him out of his shell. The Safari Park has not one but two baby giraffe calves that need to be hand-reared simultaneously.

3.o: There will be no peace in the world for the hamadryas baboons until Impo finds his mate; luckily, the San Diego Zoo keepers have a plan. Two young cheetah cubs are training to become animal ambassadors with the help of their experienced canine guide.

4.o: Safari Park keepers prepare Aria the rambunctious black rhino for her new life on the open African Plains exhibit. Zoo staff cares for 15-year-old legend M'bari the lion and his mate, Etosha. A vulture chick learns to eat from a surrogate puppet.

5.o: The Zoo says goodbye to beloved pandas Bai-Yun and Xiao Liwu as mother and cub prepare to return to China. Tembo the retired "Hollywood" elephant tries traditional Chinese medicine for her arthritis. The Butterfly Jungle gets colored for the season.

6.o: After six years away, Mek the tiger returns to the Zoo.  Two shy tree kangaroos, Spike and Polly, meet for the first time. And, with the Children's Zoo under construction, the keepers have to move over 100 animals, including a herd of reluctant goats.

7.o: Safari Park keepers say goodbye to two elephant brothers.  Can the San Diego Zoo vets design a custom shoe for Felix, an excitable three-toed Baird's Tapir? And, two African Penguin chicks grow up and get ready to join the colony.

8.o: Mkhaya, the youngest baby elephant in the Safari Park herd, learns to use her trunk. Will Alba the Andean bear become a first-time mom? Zoo vets examine Mandazzi the gorilla, and Jeff the snake chaser looks for he elusive costal patch nose snake.

9.o: A southern white rhino is pregnant with a calf that could be key in saving a species from extinction; Connor the Malayan tiger has tooth trouble; a new bird keeper learns to feed the shoebill; polar bears exercise their hunting skills on live prey.

1.t: The Birds Don't Sing, They Screech in Pain
1.ar: العصافير لا تغني، إنها تصرخ من الألم
1.o: يشعل شجار مع سائقة عدائية غضب "داني" وتنتج عنه مطاردة متأججة عبر المدينة، ويترك ضيف "أيمي" غير المتوقع انطباعًا يستحيل نسيانه.

2.ar: نشوة أن نكون على قيد الحياة
2.o: تعثر "أيمي" الحانقة على هدف جديد لنفسها بينما يبدأ زواجها الذي يبدو مثاليًّا في التدهور، ويسعى "داني" نحو بداية جديدة لمشروع عائلته المتداعي.

3.t: I Am Inhabited by a Cry
3.o: ينفّس "داني" عن انفعالاته في وجود حبيبة قديمة، وتتدهور علاقة "أيمي" و"جورج" مجددًا. وتتخطى عملية احتيال إلكتروني الحدود.

4.t: Just Not All at the Same Time
4.ar: ليس كل شيء في الوقت نفسه
4.o: في الوقت الذي يصبح فيه مستقبل "أيمي" على المحك، تتجه إلى "لاس فيغاس" من أجل العمل، في حين يتابع "بول" المتيّم و"داني" الغاضب مساعيهما الجامحة.

5.o: بينما يكسب "جورج" صديقًا جديدًا، يضع "داني" خطة خطرة، وتوافق "أيمي" على مقابلة، وتتصرّف "نايومي" بناءً على حدسها.

6.o: بسبب تعليقات "فومي" الانتقادية وتدخّل "نايومي" تصل "أيمي" و"جورج" إلى حافة الانهيار. وفيما يهرع "آيزاك" للابتعاد عن المتاعب، يتلقى "داني" عرضًا غير متوقع.

7.o: تحدث تغيّرات إيجابية في حياة "أيمي" و"داني"، ولكن الأسرار العالقة والتحديات العاطفية تجبرهما على مواجهة الحقائق القاسية.

8.o: تدفع ذكريات الشباب الأليمة "أيمي" إلى مواجهة مشاكلها الأسرية وتعاستها الزوجية. ويحوك "داني" كذبة مفصّلة تنتهي به عند منعطف خطير.

9.o: مع ظهور أزمة جديدة، تتجاوز مشاعر "داني" الخوف لتصل إلى الهلع. وتضع "أيمي" مخططًا خطيرًا وهي تعتزم القيام بأي شيء من أجل سلامة "جون".

10.o: تؤدي عواقب أفعال "داني" و"أيمي" بهما إلى موقف سريالي يختبر مدى إدراكهما لواقعهما.

1.t: All the Things We're Never Going to Have
1.ar: كل الأشياء التي لن نحظى بها أبدًا
1.o: يشهد الموظفان "أوستن" و"آشلي"، اللذان يعملان في نادٍ ريفي، شجارًا محتدمًا بين رئيسهما وزوجته، ويقرران استغلال الحدث لتحقيق مصالحهما.

2.t: A New Starting Point for Further Desires
2.o: بينما يحاول "جوش" التهوين من ترقّي "آشلي" في النادي، تسعى "ليندسي" إلى انتقام رخيص. وفي الأثناء، تقترح الرئيسة إجراء تغييرات على الصالة الرياضية.

3.t: The Increasing Flimsiness of Any Certainties About the Future
3.ar: الهشاشة المتزايدة لأي يقين بشأن المستقبل
3.o: يفكر "جوش" و"ليندسي" في بدء فصل جديد من حياتهما، بينما تحثّ "آشلي" خطيبها "أوستن" على التقرب من "يونيس".

4.t: Oh, the Comfort, the Inexpressible Comfort
4.o: حين يعلق "أوستن" و"آشلي" لساعات في غرفة الطوارئ، يتحيّن "جوش" الفرصة لقلب الطاولة عليهما.

5.t: I Am Killing My Flesh Without It
5.o: يبلغ الخلاف الزوجي بين "ليندسي" و"جوش" ذروته حين تقع أزمة مفاجئة في منزلهما.

6.o: يحاول "جوش" و"أوستن" تصفية الأجواء بينهما من خلال جلسة تدريبية، فيما تعمد "ليندسي" لتعليم "آشلي" أصول الفن الرفيع لكسب ودّ الزوجات اللاتي يرتدن النادي.

7.o: على ارتفاع ثلاثين ألف قدم، يتعكّر صفو عطلة الفتيات "آشلي" و"ليندسي" و"آفا"، التي خططن لقضائها في "سول"، بسبب توترات قديمة واكتشافات جديدة واعترافات صادمة.

8.t: It Will Stay This Way and You Will Obey
8.ar: ستبقى الأمور على هذه الحال وعليك أن تطيع
8.o: في خضم صراع من أجل البقاء تدور أحداثه في موطن الرئيسة، يتعيّن على الزوجين اختيار ما سيُضحون به، ولمن ستكون تلك التضحية.
